title.narrative: HCFC Phase-out in the PU Foam Sector Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to reduce the consumption of HCFC-141b in the foam sector in Indonesia in order to contribute to the government's effort to comply with Indonesia's HCFC phase-out obligations under the Montreal Protocol.
